description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into WooCommerce Products via the REST API v3. Search-then-write per row (WooCommerce has no native upsert) — GET /products?sku=X → PUT the match or POST a new product.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row → one WooCommerce product (upserted by matching on sku).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_errored). No downstream data — write side effect lands in WooCommerce.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column → WooCommerce field name. MUST include a mapping to `sku`.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap).

name: WooCommerce Product Upsert
